data.one_liner: A widget that resizes a child Navigator to its current route's intrinsic size.
data.what_it_does: NavigatorResizable wraps a Navigator and automatically adjusts its size to match the content of the active route. It works with standard navigation APIs and the Pages API, fixing size lag and assertion issues.
use_when: You need a Navigator that does not occupy the full screen size
You want the surrounding layout to adapt to route content size
You use go_router or auto_route and need intrinsic sizing
avoid_when: Your app relies on the default full‑screen Navigator behavior
You cannot migrate to material_ui due to widget incompatibilities
strengths: Provides intrinsic sizing for nested navigators
Fixes flicker and assertion bugs on iOS and overlays
weaknesses: Requires migration to material_ui which may cause runtime conflicts
Limited to resizing; does not add navigation features
data.setup_notes: Add navigator_resizable and material_ui to pubspec, migrate existing material imports to material_ui as described in the migration guide.
